helper_version: prime_poly v1: independent coefficient extraction from fixed support assignment/parent enumeration; compare exact intervals to v1 mass
actual_Boolean_family: n=4 truth 855 (OR of two disjoint width-two conjunctions) and its complement 64680
parameter_domain: All prime conjunctions in both orientations; all 2^N full-support gate orders (N=2 or4); all continuous packing weights are represented by exact mass polynomials. Pilot samples rational grid lambda rows, not a continuum proof.
case_count: 4+16 ordered prime tables, up to 15 nonempty sets each; initial rational test grid lambda_j in {1/4,1/2,3/4,1}, packing-feasible; <=256 weight vectors per order
justified_symmetry_reduction: None in kernel; all listed orders retained. Exploration may use automorphisms only with explicit transformations later.
arithmetic: Integer/Fraction monomial coefficients in z=2^(-6/5), W_A=sum c_{A,U,d} lambda_U z^d; 72-bit exact fifth-root z-power intervals; root normalizer rational. Floating optimization is discovery only.
candidate_constant: Exact single-table leading ratio (43+19 log2 3)/80; certify against every menu representation only if an all-weight/order lower bound is supplied
boundary_scope: Include limiting partial-zero gate faces in any infimum certificate; all-zero face needs homogeneous leading normalization, not division by zero.
